theme.en: AI Infrastructure Becomes a Full-Stack Commitment
theme.zh: AI基础设施转向全栈投入

dek.en: Nvidia and SK Group link data-center expansion to memory supply, while AMD, Intel, and a growing field of challengers push their roadmaps from individual chips toward complete systems. Capital, packaging, foundry execution, and software are increasingly moving as one stack.
dek.zh: Nvidia与SK Group把数据中心扩张同存储供应绑定，AMD、Intel及一批新势力则把路线图从单颗芯片推进到完整系统。资本、封装、晶圆代工执行力与软件正日益作为同一套技术栈协同推进。

title.en: AI & Accelerators
title.zh: AI与加速器

title.en: Nvidia and SK Group Unveil $500 Billion-Plus AI Infrastructure Initiative
title.zh: Nvidia与SK Group公布逾5000亿美元AI基础设施计划

summary.en: Nvidia and SK Group unveiled an AI data-center initiative described as exceeding $500 billion alongside a memory partnership. The combination ties accelerator deployment more directly to SK's memory and infrastructure capacity, highlighting that compute availability now depends on coordinated investment across the stack.
summary.zh: Nvidia与SK Group公布一项规模据称超过5000亿美元的AI数据中心计划，并同步推进存储合作。该组合把加速器部署与SK的存储及基础设施产能更直接地绑定，表明算力供给越来越依赖整条技术栈的协同投资。

title.en: AMD Frames Its AI Roadmap at Rack Scale
title.zh: AMD把AI路线图推向机架级

summary.en: AMD is pursuing the AI infrastructure market through rack-scale system roadmaps rather than selling accelerators as isolated components. The strategy raises the importance of networking, memory, power, cooling, and software integration, the layers that determine whether GPU specifications translate into deployable cluster performance.
summary.zh: AMD正通过机架级系统路线图争夺AI基础设施市场，而不再把加速器作为孤立部件销售。该策略提升了网络、存储、供电、散热和软件集成的重要性，因为这些层面决定GPU规格能否转化为可部署的集群性能。

title.en: Foundry & Manufacturing
title.zh: 晶圆代工与制造

title.en: Intel Foundry Execution Improves, but Outside Revenue Remains Small
title.zh: Intel Foundry执行力改善，但外部收入仍偏小

summary.en: Intel's fab execution is improving, but its foundry business generated only $293 million in external revenue. That figure leaves customer adoption, rather than internal process progress alone, as the central test of whether Intel can establish a credible alternative to TSMC.
summary.zh: Intel晶圆厂的执行情况正在改善，但其代工业务外部收入仅为2.93亿美元。这意味着客户采用度，而非仅仅内部制程进展，仍是检验Intel能否成为TSMC可信替代者的核心指标。

title.en: TSMC CoPoS and Intel EMIB Target Different Packaging Constraints
title.zh: TSMC CoPoS与Intel EMIB瞄准不同封装约束

summary.en: A comparison of TSMC's emerging CoPoS panel-level approach and Intel's EMIB bridge technology shows two routes to integrating ever-larger heterogeneous chiplet systems. Both address the scaling limits of advanced packaging, but their different physical tradeoffs will shape substrate size, interconnect density, and manufacturing economics.
summary.zh: 一项对比显示，TSMC新兴的CoPoS面板级方案与Intel的EMIB桥接技术代表了集成更大规模异构chiplet系统的两条路径。两者都在应对先进封装的扩展极限，但不同的物理权衡将影响基板尺寸、互连密度和制造经济性。

title.en: Memory
title.zh: 存储

title.en: Qualcomm Signals a Double-Digit Flagship Chip Price Increase
title.zh: Qualcomm预示旗舰芯片价格将上涨两位数

summary.en: Qualcomm told customers that higher supplier costs will require a double-digit price increase, with the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 family among the products expected to be affected. Rising 2nm wafer costs and the DRAM shortage are pushing memory and foundry inflation into handset silicon even as smartphone demand remains soft.
summary.zh: Qualcomm已告知客户，供应商成本上升将迫使其进行两位数涨价，预计Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6系列也会受到影响。2nm晶圆成本上升与DRAM短缺正把存储和代工端的通胀传导至手机芯片，而智能手机需求仍然偏弱。

title.en: CXMT Explores Custom DRAM as HBM Tool Controls Bite
title.zh: HBM设备管制收紧，CXMT转向定制DRAM

summary.en: CXMT is exploring customized DRAM, 3D memory, and 3D integration as U.S. restrictions limit its access to equipment needed for mainstream HBM production. The approach could create an alternative path into AI memory, but it remains a strategic proposal rather than evidence that CXMT has closed the manufacturing and bandwidth gap with Korean suppliers.
summary.zh: 在美国限制其获取主流HBM生产所需设备之际，CXMT正探索定制DRAM、3D存储和3D集成。该路线可能为进入AI存储市场提供替代路径，但目前仍是战略设想，尚不能证明CXMT已经缩小与韩国供应商之间的制造和带宽差距。

title.en: Policy & Geopolitics
title.zh: 政策与地缘政治

title.en: Nvidia and 24 Companies Oppose a Chinese Open-Model Ban
title.zh: Nvidia等25家公司反对禁止中国开放权重模型

summary.en: Nvidia and 24 other companies signed a letter defending open-weight AI as Washington considers restrictions on Chinese models. Chipmakers, server vendors, cloud operators, and software firms joined the effort, while OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google were absent, exposing a policy split over whether model openness supports or undermines U.S. technology interests.
summary.zh: 在华盛顿考虑限制中国AI模型之际，Nvidia与另外24家公司联署支持开放权重AI。芯片商、服务器厂商、云运营商和软件公司参与其中，而OpenAI、Anthropic和Google缺席，显示业界对模型开放究竟有利还是不利于美国科技利益存在政策分歧。

title.en: Earnings & Markets
title.zh: 财报与市场

title.en: Intel Commits to a 2028 High-Volume Ramp for 14A
title.zh: Intel承诺14A于2028年进入大规模量产

summary.en: Intel says its 14A process remains on track for a high-volume production ramp in 2028 as company sales rose 25% year over year and earnings exceeded guidance. The financial improvement gives Intel more room to fund the roadmap, but 14A's foundry credibility will ultimately depend on external customer products reaching volume.
summary.zh: Intel表示14A制程仍按计划于2028年进入大规模量产；公司销售额同比增长25%，盈利也超过业绩指引。财务改善为Intel投入路线图提供了更大空间，但14A的代工可信度最终仍取决于外部客户产品能否实现量产。

title.en: Challengers & New Silicon
title.zh: 新势力与新硅

title.en: AMD and Cerebras Join Forces on AI Inference
title.zh: AMD与Cerebras联手推进AI推理

summary.en: AMD and Cerebras have formed an AI inference collaboration, linking an established accelerator supplier with Cerebras' wafer-scale architecture. The announcement expands the competitive set for inference deployments, although its impact will depend on named workloads, customers, and production-scale installations.
summary.zh: AMD与Cerebras建立AI推理合作，把成熟加速器供应商与Cerebras的晶圆级架构连接起来。该合作扩大了推理部署的竞争版图，但实际影响仍取决于明确的工作负载、客户以及生产规模的落地。

title.en: Microchip Agrees to Acquire Edge-AI Chipmaker Hailo
title.zh: Microchip同意收购边缘AI芯片公司Hailo

summary.en: Microchip Technology signed a definitive agreement to acquire Hailo, bringing the challenger's edge-AI accelerators into a broad embedded-chip portfolio. The deal gives Hailo a larger sales and support channel while giving Microchip a faster route into deployed neural-network inference at the edge; financial terms were not disclosed in the candidate item.
summary.zh: Microchip Technology签署最终协议收购Hailo，把这家新势力的边缘AI加速器纳入其广泛的嵌入式芯片组合。该交易为Hailo带来更大的销售和支持渠道，也让Microchip更快进入边缘神经网络推理市场；候选信息未披露财务条款。

title.en: Etched Raises $300 Million at a $10.3 Billion Valuation
title.zh: Etched融资3亿美元，估值达103亿美元

summary.en: Etched closed a $300 million Series C at a $10.3 billion valuation, doubling its valuation in seven months as reported inference-chip orders reached $1 billion. The round is a substantial vote on specialized inference silicon, but converting orders into installed systems and repeat demand remains the operating test.
summary.zh: Etched完成3亿美元C轮融资，估值达到103亿美元，7个月内翻倍；据报道，其推理芯片订单已达10亿美元。该轮融资是资本对专用推理芯片的一次重注，但把订单转化为已安装系统和持续复购仍是运营层面的检验。

theme.en: Memory Traffic Becomes the Optimization Target
theme.zh: 内存流量成为优化主目标

dek.en: This week's strongest systems papers attack the hidden cost of moving and retaining state: draft-model KV reads, cache eviction, low-bit activation transforms, and adapter capacity. The recurring lesson is that efficiency claims need attribution and bounded working sets, not just smaller nominal models.
dek.zh: 本周最值得关注的系统论文集中处理状态搬运与保留的隐性成本：草稿模型的KV读取、缓存淘汰、低比特激活变换以及适配器容量。反复出现的结论是，效率不仅取决于名义上的模型缩小，还需要可归因的误差和有界工作集。

title.en: AI Accelerators & Compute-in-Memory
title.zh: AI加速器与存算一体

title.en: Windowed-MTP Removes Full-Context Draft KV Reads
title.zh: Windowed-MTP消除草稿模型的全上下文KV读取

summary.en: Windowed-MTP applies a sliding attention window and sink only to the multi-token-prediction draft head, preventing draft cost from growing with a million-token KV cache. Full-attention verification remains unchanged, so the method can alter proposed tokens but not the target model's accepted output. It is a training-free systems optimization; the preprint still needs independent evaluation across model families and serving stacks.
summary.zh: Windowed-MTP仅在多Token预测草稿头中应用滑动注意力窗口和attention sink，避免草稿成本随百万Token KV缓存线性增长。全注意力验证保持不变，因此该方法可以改变候选Token，却不会改变目标模型最终接受的输出。这是一项免训练的系统优化，但仍需在不同模型家族和推理栈上进行独立评估。

title.en: KroQuant Uses Kronecker Blocks for W4A4 Diffusion Transformers
title.zh: KroQuant以Kronecker块实现扩散Transformer的W4A4量化

papers.authors: Yann Bouquet, Alireza Khodamoradi, Kristof Denolf, et al.

summary.en: KroQuant introduces learned Kronecker-structured invertible transforms on 32-element activation blocks to make W4A4 post-training quantization practical for diffusion transformers. The block-local construction targets the online transform cost that recurs at every denoising step and stores less than half as many parameters as per-channel scaling. The preprint's value will depend on whether image quality and latency gains persist on current accelerator kernels rather than only in calibration experiments.
summary.zh: KroQuant在32元素激活块上引入可学习的Kronecker结构可逆变换，以提升扩散Transformer进行W4A4训练后量化的可行性。其块内结构针对每个去噪步骤都会重复出现的在线变换成本，参数存储量不到逐通道缩放的一半。该预印本的价值取决于图像质量与延迟收益能否在现有加速器kernel上保持，而不只是在校准实验中成立。

title.en: AI Research for Hardware
title.zh: 面向硬件的AI研究

title.en: Randomized KV Eviction Produces Serving-Time Error Certificates
title.zh: 随机化KV淘汰可生成推理时误差证书

summary.en: The paper proves that deterministic top-k KV-cache eviction cannot consistently estimate the attention error caused by discarded values, then restores identifiability with Poisson sampling and a Hájek correction. Its certificate reached 0.97 empirical coverage and distinguished cache-induced from inherent failures at AUC 0.73-0.75, but it did not improve failure prediction or certificate-gated budget escalation. The result is useful precisely because it narrows the claim: randomization supports attribution, not a universal serving-quality predictor.
summary.zh: 论文证明，确定性的top-k KV缓存淘汰无法一致估计丢弃value造成的注意力误差，随后通过Poisson采样和Hájek校正恢复可识别性。误差证书取得0.97的经验覆盖率，并以0.73至0.75的AUC区分缓存诱发故障与固有故障，但未改善故障预测或证书驱动的预算升级。该结果的价值正在于收窄了主张：随机化有助于误差归因，而不是提供通用的推理质量预测器。

title.en: Early Activations Weakly Predict Reasoning Non-Convergence
title.zh: 早期激活可弱预测推理不收敛

papers.authors: Renuka Oladri, Niveda Jawahar, Abdirisak Mohamed

summary.en: On DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, converged chains scored 90.3% on AIME 1983-2024 while budget-exhausted chains scored 6.6%, with only 62.0% of generations converging. A linear probe at layer 20 and token 150 achieved AUC 0.608, suggesting a modest early signal that could support stopping policies. The permutation result was p=0.063, so the evidence does not yet clear conventional significance thresholds and should not be treated as a production-ready predictor.
summary.zh: 在DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B上，收敛推理链在AIME 1983-2024上的准确率为90.3%，耗尽Token预算的推理链仅为6.6%，总体收敛率为62.0%。位于第20层、第150个Token的线性探针取得0.608 AUC，说明存在可用于提前停止策略的弱信号。置换检验结果为p=0.063，尚未达到常规显著性阈值，因此不能把它视为可直接用于生产的预测器。

title.en: Measuring How Many Bits a LoRA Adapter Can Store
title.zh: 量化LoRA适配器能够存储多少比特

papers.authors: Kaizhen Tan, Heqing Du, Yang Feng

summary.en: A compression-based analysis finds that LoRA adapters store only a few bits per trainable parameter, and that placement matters more than raw parameter count. Moving the same budget from attention into the MLP nearly doubled capacity, while removing structure from the frozen base largely erased it; measured privacy leakage tracked stored bits more closely than nominal adapter size. The study reframes adapter design and risk around effective information capacity, though its conclusions still depend on the tested Qwen2.5 fine-tuning setups.
summary.zh: 一项基于压缩的分析发现，LoRA适配器每个可训练参数只存储少量比特，而且参数位置比名义数量更重要。把相同预算从attention移到MLP后容量接近翻倍，而去除冻结基座的结构后容量几乎消失；测得的隐私泄露也更紧密地跟随实际写入比特，而非适配器名义大小。该研究把适配器设计与风险重新聚焦于有效信息容量，但结论仍取决于所测试的Qwen2.5微调设置。

title.en: Quantum Computing
title.zh: 量子计算

title.en: Deeper Parameterized Quantum Circuits Show Double Descent
title.zh: 更深参数化量子电路呈现双下降现象

papers.authors: Marie Kempkes, Elies Gil-Fuster, Carlos Bravo-Prieto, et al.

summary.en: The authors show analytically and numerically that gradient-trained parameterized quantum circuits can improve out-of-sample performance as model size grows, exhibiting double descent rather than monotonically worsening generalization. Experiments on re-uploading circuits across several datasets support the predicted scaling behavior. The evidence is numerical rather than a hardware demonstration, so noise, trainability, and device depth remain separate obstacles to practical quantum machine learning.
summary.zh: 作者通过解析推导和数值实验表明，采用梯度训练的参数化量子电路可随模型规模扩大而改善样本外表现，呈现双下降现象，而不是泛化能力单调恶化。在多个数据集上的re-uploading电路实验支持这一预测的扩展规律。不过证据来自数值实验而非硬件演示，噪声、可训练性和器件深度仍是实用量子机器学习的独立障碍。

title.en: EDA & Design Automation
title.zh: EDA与设计自动化

title.en: A Three-Stage Optimizer for Fixed-Outline Chip Floorplanning
title.zh: 面向固定轮廓芯片布局的三阶段优化器

papers.authors: Yilihamujiang Yimamu, Guillem Pastor-Rué, Jordi Cortadella

summary.en: This floorplanning framework combines quadratic placement, Adam-based non-convex global optimization, and convex legalization based on horizontal and vertical constraint graphs. On MCNC, GSRC, and HB+ benchmarks, it reduced average half-perimeter wirelength by at least 1% and 5% versus the compared state-of-the-art floorplanners. The gains are benchmark results rather than tape-out evidence, so downstream timing, routability, and runtime behavior remain to be demonstrated.
summary.zh: 该布局规划框架依次结合二次布局、基于Adam的非凸全局优化，以及依托水平和垂直约束图的凸合法化。在MCNC、GSRC和HB+基准上，其平均半周长线长相较所对比的先进布局器至少降低1%和5%。这些收益来自基准测试而非流片验证，后续时序、可布线性和运行时间表现仍有待证明。
